misprints.note: Ending printed without an accent. Kept as printed. Probably normal for an ending.
No breathing is printed after the parenthesised prefix. Kept as printed.
There is no stop after τό, and the comma before ταγμα is odd. Kept as printed.

uncertain.note: The breathing on ε at the end of the strip is small. I read it as rough (ἕνος), but it could be smooth (ἔνος).
The mark after ἔμπροσθεν is faint. It could be a period or a broken comma. I wrote a period.
The final stop is printed raised, like a middle dot. I wrote a period.
The word is split at the line end as 'προς-' / 'τάττειν', with final ς. I joined it as προςτάττειν.
